title: Issues & pull requests
description: Choose a workspace and repository to review GitHub work or start an Agent from an Issue.
noWorkspaces: Add a workspace to this project to connect a repository.
chooseRepository: Choose a repository remote to continue.
selectIssue: Select an Issue to review its description, labels, and discussion.
planningPrompt: Use the requirements-planning skill to clarify and break down this project's requirements into GitHub Issue drafts. First inspect the selected workspace and relevant existing Issues. Ask me about unclear goals or constraints before proposing the task breakdown. Do not create Issues until I review and explicitly approve the drafts.
pullRequestReviewDescription: Review the branch and edit the title and description before pushing and creating a PR.
uncommittedChanges: Commit or discard uncommitted changes before creating a PR.
invalidIssueNumbers: Enter positive Issue numbers separated by commas.
pushConfirmation: Continuing will push branch {{branch}} to this repository and create a pull request.
prepareFirst: Prepare the branch before creating a PR.
issueDraftsHelp: Paste the JSON draft list from the requirements-planning Agent. Review each draft, validate repository metadata and duplicates, then explicitly create the batch.
linkPlanningThread: Link created Issues to an Agent thread
invalidDraftJson: Enter a JSON array of Issue drafts, or an object with a drafts array.
draftsNeedChanges: Resolve the validation errors before creating Issues.
partialCreateFailure: The batch stopped after some Issues were created: {{error}}
